why: The Solver's own output contract requires {"scenario":"...","action":"...","entities":[]} on a row whose speech expresses no entity, and says so in words ("If no entity is expressed, return an empty entities array"). The released exemplar supply shows that case 2,949 times and renders its answer as the bare English word 'none', which occurs in no legal Solver response. Module M1's admitted gain was convention transfer from the raw line; this release extends exactly that mechanism to the empty case, at zero contacts and with the retrieval key side untouched, so a construction-variant cell can test whether showing the correct empty ANSWER moves the ENTITY-FP-ONLY mass.
